intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Boulder for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (St. Nick on the Bricks) through December 18 (Christmas Candlelight Festival), with Tebo Train's Snowflake Express (November 29), Jingle Bells & Pines: A Family Holiday Concert (December 6) and Winterfest at Chautauqua (December 11) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Boulder

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Boulder
  • 3 free events, including St. Nick on the Bricks, Jingle Bells & Pines: A Family Holiday Concert and Winterfest at Chautauqua
  • Meet Santa: St. Nick on the Bricks, free, from November 27
  • Trains and crafts: Tebo Train's Snowflake Express, suggested donation $5 per group, and Decorate a Yule Log
  • Season: November 27, 2026 to December 18, 2026

Planning a bigger day out? Boulder families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Denver, which covers Zoo Lights, Blossoms of Light at the Denver Botanic Gardens and the big downtown tree lightings.
